back: The energy used by a 1 kW appliance in 1 hour: $3.6 \times 10^{6}\ \text{J}$.

front: How do you calculate the cost of electricity?
back: Energy (kW h) = power (kW) × time (h); cost = energy × price per kW h.
Watt: unit of power (rate). Kilowatt-hour: unit of energy (what you pay for).

front: Which appliances use the most energy at home?
back: Heating appliances (geysers, stoves, kettles, irons), because they have high power ratings.
